title: architecture v1 judgment record
description: One line of judgments.jsonl: the APPEND-ONLY authority for MEANING. DECISIONS ONLY -- an observed provider fact must never be written here merely because a projection ran. Records fold last-write-wins by FILE ORDER for a given arch_id; decided_at is audit only, so a clock skew cannot reorder meaning. The log is never compacted or rewritten in place.

kind.description: Closed: an unknown kind is a validation error, never a silent pass.

arch_id.description: Absent only for a decision that names no single node.

decided_at.description: Human audit only. File order -- not this timestamp -- is authoritative.

record_id.description: Content-derived over the record MINUS record_id and checksum, so stamping is idempotent and a duplicated append is an exact repeat.

checksum.description: Over the record MINUS checksum, so it covers record_id. Per-record integrity is what lets a reader truncate-and-report a torn TRAILING line while hard-aborting on corruption anywhere else -- append_line_atomic gives durability, not crash atomicity.

allOf.description: Identity allocation is the one atomic append that PRECEDES any manifest or file write, so it must name the identity it allocates.
